name: Deformation Network for 4D Gaussian Splatting
definition: A neural network module that predicts dynamic 3D Gaussian parameters (means, scales, rotations, opacity, SH coefficients) from static input points, scales, rotations, opacity, SHs, and time. It uses positional encoding for position, pose, and time, and a separate time network to modulate the deformation.
summary: The Deformation Network predicts dynamic 3D Gaussian parameters from static features and time, enabling 4D scene reconstruction via a dedicated time-conditioned MLP.
